invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieIndex instance or throws an exception.
A non-null HoodieWriteConfig is required to create any HoodieIndex; otherwise, NullPointerException would occur.
If no index class is specified, the switch on config.getIndexType() requires it to be non-null.
Returned object is always a HoodieIndex (or subclass thereof) by design.
